result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity. I changed one line in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the `listStockByWarehouse` query gets `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

`findStockQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. The only other caller of the list is the demo scenario's printout, which will simply show fewer lines.

I ran the `*Stock*` tests offline and they pass. I did not run the full suite, and I did not add a test for the empty-line case. Nothing is committed.
